name: Carousel-TS-TW
title: Animated Card Carousel
description: One rounded card at a time shows an icon, a bold title and a short blurb. Dragging it sideways, or tapping the dots, slides the next card in with a slight 3D turn.
use: A small deck of feature or testimonial cards should be browsed by drag and dots rather than a full-width slider.
avoid: The card is a fixed 300px wide and the default copy is baked in, so real content needs prop overrides.
a11y: The dots are labelled focusable buttons, but dragging the card has no keyboard equivalent and motion is never reduced. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card sits inside a bordered frame, holding a small round icon badge, a bold white heading and two lines of pale copy. Five small dots run beneath it, the active one larger.
behaves: Dragging the card sideways brings in the next or previous slide, each card turning slightly in 3D as it travels. A spring settles it into place and the dot row marks the current slide.
customise: Pass the item list, width, autoplay, delay, pause-on-hover, loop and round mode as props; icons and the dark palette live in the source.
weight: light: A handful of small card nodes and one spring tween per move; idle when nobody drags.
demo: Five slides titled Text Animations, Animations, Components, Backgrounds and Common UI, each with a short blurb.
polishWhy: Tidy spring swipe and clear dots, but the flat dark card styling is fairly ordinary.
